nom: Palmer's Coconut Sugar Facial Scrub Exfoliator with Chamomile (3.17 Oz)

segments.dry: Reviewers using the scrub on dry skin or dry areas, including one in a dry winter climate, report it leaves skin smoother and softer without feeling stripped.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no redness or discomfort, including one who found it fine even with mild acne, but one reviewer explicitly warns it is not for sensitive skin and posted a photo of a reaction after use, especially cautioning against the eye area.
segments.mature: One 43-year-old reviewer with fine lines and enlarged, clogged pores reports her skin looked noticeably smoother and brighter within a week of use.

concerns.aging: One 43-year-old reviewer with fine lines and enlarged, clogged pores reports her skin looked noticeably smoother and brighter within a week, enough that her partner asked if she'd had cosmetic work done.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the scrub leaves skin feeling moisturized rather than dried out after exfoliating, though one reviewer says she wouldn't call it moisturizing, just that it doesn't dry her skin out either.
concerns.redness: One reviewer explicitly says it left her skin free of redness or irritation, but another warns it is not for sensitive skin and posted a photo of a visible reaction two days after using it, especially cautioning against use near the eyes.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with occasionally open acne reports the scrub hasn't caused breakouts and, in her opinion, has helped her acne heal, though she noted slight burning when used over active blemishes.

aspects.libelle: Gentle but gritty texture, effective without harshness
Affordable, good value for the size
Granules dissolve in water, don't clog drains
Recurring packaging issues: missing, empty, unsealed or hard to open
Small tube size relative to expectations

extraits.texte: This product is definitely not for sensitive skin and should not be used around your eyes. This photo was taken 2 days after using the facial scrub.

This is a good, budget exfoliator. The sugar granules do not dissolve too fast so you’ll have plenty of time to scrub. I think it’s fine for sensitive skin but I have experienced slight burning when I had open acne but nothing significant. It hasn’t broke me out and in my opinion has helped heal my acne. It’s moisturizing in the sense that it doesn’t dry your skin out but it doesn’t leave a thick moisture film either, which is good for me. I recommend cleansing before using as this is an exfoliator and not a cleanser. I also recommend rinsing completely as granules can stick to your face after use. This comes unsealed. It is a legitimate product as I compared it to the one I purchased at Walgreens and everything is the same. This is truly one of the best drugstore exfoliators on the market right now for most skin types. When used properly it gives excellent results.

Palmer's Coconut Oil Formula Coconut Sugar Facial Scrub Exfoliator is a gentle yet effective skincare product designed for those looking to refresh and nourish their skin. Ideal for anyone wanting a natural exfoliation experience, this scrub combines the moisturizing benefits of coconut oil with the exfoliating power of coconut sugar. The scrub's texture is pleasantly grainy but smooth enough to avoid irritation, making it suitable for sensitive skin types. As you massage it onto your face, the coconut sugar gently buffs away dead skin cells, revealing a brighter, smoother complexion. Meanwhile, the coconut oil deeply hydrates, leaving skin feeling soft and supple rather than dry or tight. One of the standout features is its delightful, natural coconut scent, which makes skincare feel like a small indulgence. After using the scrub, my skin looked noticeably more radiant and felt refreshed without any redness or discomfort. It's a perfect addition to a weekly skincare routine to maintain healthy, glowing skin. Overall, Palmer's Coconut Oil Formula Coconut Sugar Facial Scrub Exfoliator strikes a lovely balance between gentle exfoliation and rich moisturization. It’s an excellent choice for those seeking a natural, effective way to brighten their skin while enjoying the nourishing qualities of coconut oil. I would recommend it to anyone wanting a simple, pleasant exfoliator that delivers visible results without harshness.

I've tried many face scrubs, and the one that I had used the most is St. Ive's Apricot Face Scrub. I didn't like how I felt it tore off my face, but I figured it was normal for any type of scrub. Enter Palmer's Coconut Scrub - I was influenced into buying this by @thesisterstudioig and was a little skeptical about it working for me. I know the importance of exfoliating, especially in the dry winter climate where I live, so I wanted to give it a shot. After trying it, I fell in love and it is now part of my weekly skin regimen. Now, I'm on my second tube of the scrub and have it on subscribe and save so I don't run out. Here are the three things that I like most about this coconut scrub: 1. Gentle on my skin, yet effective. Unlike the St. Ive's Apricot Scrub, I don't feel like this is ripping my skin to pieces. Although it is gentle, I notice the my skin is smoother and softer after I use it (I use it every other day). 2. Natural I love that it is natural and doesn't have any of the bad stuff. I try to be more aware of what I put on my skin, but I'm not always conscious of what is in the beauty products I use. I love that I can feel comfortable using this every other day. 3. Affordable and Last a Long Time The last thing I love about this product is that it isn't expensive and a little goes a long way!
